definitions.gloss: the Yamanote Line; the JR loop line circling central Tokyo
definitions.explanation: The circular JR line that connects Tokyo's main hubs — Tokyo, Shinagawa, Shibuya, Shinjuku, Ikebukuro, and Ueno. Because it links almost every major district, it functions as the backbone of the city and as the mental map ordinary residents use for central Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {山手線|やまのてせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'll go on the Yamanote Line.

examples.japanese: {山手線|やまのてせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧。
examples.english: The morning rush on the Yamanote Line is intense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝過|ねす}ごして→寝過ごす：18375_nesugosu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{山手線|やまのてせん}なら⟦{一周|いっしゅう}→一周：08917_isshuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧こられる。
examples.english: Even if you fall asleep past your stop, on the Yamanote Line you can just ride the loop back around.

notes:
Note the reading: the line is やまのてせん, though the place name {山手|やまて} elsewhere is read やまて.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {内回|うちまわ}り: the inner loop, running clockwise on the map
- ⟦{外回|そとまわ}り→外回り：17708_sotomawari⟧: the outer loop, running counterclockwise
- {山手線|やまのてせん}⟦{内|うち}→内：01328_uchi⟧: inside the loop — shorthand for central, expensive Tokyo
- {山手線|やまのてせん}⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧: a word-chain party game named after the line's stations

CULTURAL NOTE:
Property ads and conversation use {山手線|やまのてせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧ (inside the loop) as a rough boundary of central Tokyo, much as Londoners speak of Zone 1. The line's green livery is so familiar that ⟦{黄緑|きみどり}→黄緑：15605_kimidori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧ alone identifies it.
